compliant.txt.evidence: Three changes wait for the owner's merge in one repository, so they are combined into one pull request from the current base: one review of its exact head with no open finding, passing required checks, one merge. The three originals are closed, each with a link to the combined pull request. A change for a second repository stays apart; the owner questions page says why and gives the merge order.

violating.txt.evidence: Five pull requests in one repository are handed to the owner to merge one by one, with no reason given; each waits for the one before it to merge and then for its own update and checks.

near-miss.txt.evidence: The changes are combined into one pull request with a clean review and passing checks, but the five originals are left open beside it. a combined pull request whose originals stay open.
near-miss.txt.non_substitute: a combined pull request whose originals stay open
